biggest_catch: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — and after 18 consecutive months without a cashback order, a $2 monthly maintenance deduction eats the balance, so you must keep earning to protect it.
catches: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — rates and merchants change.

The $10 available-balance minimum and the $2/month maintenance deduction after 18 consecutive months without cashback orders were found only in third-party quotations of the official FAQ/terms, not confirmed by loading the official page in this session — treat the exact figures as needing re-check on the live terms.
Merchants initially confirm the order in 2–7 days, but cashback only becomes available after the return period — this is not fast money.
Returned or cancelled items reverse the cashback.
Coupon codes from other sites or ad blockers can break tracking.

steps: Create a free account at https://gocashback.com/.
Find the store and click through to it from the GoCashBack portal in the same session.
Complete your purchase as normal — avoid outside coupon codes and ad blockers on the order.
Check your account after 2–7 days for the merchant's initial order confirmation.
Wait for the cashback to become available after the store's return period.
Keep shopping at least occasionally so you never hit 18 consecutive months without a cashback order.
Once your available balance reaches $10, withdraw via PayPal, Alipay, or check.
